$comment: Skills I use that live in someone else's repo. They are pointers, not copies: install them straight from the source so their authors' updates reach you. `pinned` is the commit I last read and accepted; .github/workflows/external-skills-watch.yml opens an issue when upstream moves past it. Bump `pinned` only after reading the upstream diff.

skills.name: i-have-adhd
skills.why: Output shaping for a reader with ADHD: lead with the next action, number multi-step work, restate state across turns, suppress tangents. Pairs with the TLDR-first status these skills ask for.
